_comment: SATELLITE: particle-count convergence CHECK (plan-v2 B6). ONE headline cell -- cube26 GRF bounded+substep (MATCHED to core_v3 arm 02), M=100, S co-fit [3..35] ternary, 546 steps -- run at particle_count in {1000,2000,4000}. N IS the swept variable (the whole point), so this is NOT a lower-quality study: 2000+4000 are the FULL production+above resolution required to show the chi2/dof plateau and (at N>=2000) the PF2 shear/dipole. particle_count is a CONFIG-WIDE scalar in sweep.py, so each N is its own arm. A CHECK, not a ladder. Run via launch_sweep_detached.ps1 -IncludeSatellites.
